findings: RG-101 HIGH PENDING_BUSINESS_DECISION — docs/requirements/requirements-specification.md:131,160-180,298-325; affected FR-024, FR-025, FR-028, FR-032, FR-037, FR-038, FR-042, FR-043. The approved sources authorize status changes and updates but do not define initial API-visible states, permitted source-to-target transition matrices, or mutable fields for Party, Party Identifier, and Identifier Scheme updates. Terms such as "valid transition" and "valid update" therefore lack a test oracle. Architecture would have to invent business lifecycle behavior. Required action: record the exact lifecycle and mutability decisions through factoryctl. Decision owner: Alex / responsable del proyecto. Disposition: prevents architecture readiness.

RG-102 HIGH MISSING_AUDIT_REQUIREMENT — docs/requirements/requirements-specification.md:58,129,150,290,399-415; affected BR-021, FR-014, SR-005, AC-022. Every decryption must create audit evidence, while audit storage is explicitly outside service ownership, but no audit destination, owner, durability boundary, retention expectation, or behavior when audit recording fails is defined. The specification does not establish whether restricted plaintext must be withheld when evidence cannot be durably recorded. Required action: decide the audit capability boundary and fail-closed or alternative failure semantics through factoryctl. Decision owner: Alex / responsable del proyecto. Disposition: prevents safe architecture of identifier decryption.

RG-103 HIGH UNTESTABLE_REQUIREMENT — docs/requirements/requirements-specification.md:209,279,395 and DBML:280; affected DR-004, SR-002, SR-004, AC-010. The package requires a "safe" or "approved" masked identifier representation but identifies no approved masking policy, scheme-specific rule, disclosure threshold, or authority. AC-010 consequently has no objective oracle for whether a mask protects restricted identifier data. Required action: approve measurable masking outcomes or an authoritative policy source. Decision owner: Alex / responsable del proyecto. Disposition: prevents approval of the sensitive-data contract.

RG-104 HIGH MISSING_IDEMPOTENCY_RULE — docs/requirements/requirements-specification.md:146,152-155,192; affected FR-010, FR-016, FR-017, FR-018, FR-019, VR-008. Duplicate client-command execution is foreseeable for create and add operations, but the package merely says no general command-idempotency obligation is approved. It does not decide whether duplicate commands may create duplicate Parties or side effects, nor define replay, key-reuse, timeout, or concurrent-duplicate outcomes. Required action: explicitly approve command replay semantics, including any operations intentionally left non-idempotent. Decision owner: Alex / responsable del proyecto. Disposition: prevents architecture from choosing data-integrity behavior.

RG-105 HIGH PENDING_BUSINESS_DECISION — docs/requirements/requirements-specification.md:98,115,141,187,222-237 and DBML:232-233; affected BR-007, FR-005, FR-018, VR-003. Identifier Schemes refer to versioned normalizer and validator implementation keys, but the package does not identify the authoritative supported-key catalog, ownership, provisioning boundary, or behavior when an administrator supplies an unknown, retired, or unavailable key. Architecture cannot safely determine whether scheme creation, activation, or identifier processing must fail. Required action: approve the rule-catalog ownership and unsupported-key lifecycle behavior. Decision owner: Alex / responsable del proyecto. Disposition: prevents architecture readiness for identifier validation.

RG-106 HIGH PENDING_BUSINESS_DECISION — docs/requirements/requirements-specification.md:199-202,415,482-489; affected VR-015 through VR-018 and AC-063 through AC-066. The repaired traceability matrix cites prior finding RG-005 as part of source authority. A gate finding is not business authority. In particular, indefinite recoverability, prohibition of automatic discard, and retry/dead-letter boundaries are not fully established by OD-005 or the DBML. Required action: record the intended failed-event retention, retry, operator intervention, and discard/dead-letter boundaries through factoryctl, then trace requirements only to authoritative sources. Decision owner: Alex / responsable del proyecto. Disposition: prevents approval of recovery behavior.

RG-107 MEDIUM MISSING_REQUIREMENT — docs/requirements/requirements-specification.md:159,167,172,177,191,222,296,301,309,315,321; affected FR-023, FR-031, FR-036, FR-041, VR-007, IR-005. Paginated searches and stable errors are required, but supported filters, sorting guarantees, page limits/defaults, and the stable error-code categories beyond selected HTTP cases remain undefined. Required action: add requirements-level observable limits and categories before the downstream API contract is approved. Decision owner: requirements specification author. Disposition: nonblocking only after the high-risk decisions are resolved.
